newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: First Holdings forms pipeline subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: First Holdings forms pipeline subsidiary.

text.p: First Philippine Holdings Corp said on Tuesday it had incorporated a new wholly-owned subsidiary which will construct and operate an oil pipeline north of Manila.
First Philippine Pipeline Inc has an authorised capital stock of 500 million pesos, of which 125 million pesos are subscribed.
First Philippine Industrial Corp, another subsidiary of First Philippine Holdings, has been operating a similar pipeline from southern Batangas province to Manila for almost three decades.
